summary: City page read: 10 electric + water sites, dump, showers nearby, $35 RV / $10 tent, pre-register with City Hall, summer months. Booking now reservable by phone; groups manual; note cleaned. Pin ok (~65 m from the loop).
flags: PIN: stored 48.24203,-101.12319 is at the street corner on the park/playground block; the gravel RV loop with angled spurs sits just north across the street, centred ~48.24255,-101.12360 (~65 m): ok, optional nudge.
BOOKING: stored had none; the city says 'Pre-register by contacting City Hall' -> reservable true, platform phone.

LONG-STAY: the city offers 'overnight, weekly, or extended stay lodging during the summer months'; imagery shows the loop nearly empty and no parked long-term units, and the posted daily rate is the lead price. Not mostly seasonal.
OWNERSHIP: HHS licence holder is the Surrey Park District; local stands. PHONE 701-852-4154 and WEBSITE https://www.surreynd.org/lodging-camping confirmed.
